title: DONNELLY, Elizabeth (Betty): Death
textSnippet: DONNELLY, Elizabeth (Betty): Death : Irish Times The Irish Times My Account --> Subscribe Sign In --> Family Notices Irish Times Family Notices Recent Notices Book a notice Sign in Notice Condolences DONNELLY, Elizabeth (Betty): Death Death 477 --> Published on the Irish Times website on 28th April 2024 DONNELLY, (née Donegan) Elizabeth (Betty) – Dundrum (and formerly of Kilmurry, Baltinglass, Co. Wicklow) April 25, 2024 (peacefully) after a short illness in St. Vincent's University Hospital. Beloved wife of Martin and loving mother of Anne, Eleanor, Elizabeth, Martin, Mary Clare, Margaret and Michael. She will be sadly missed and remembered with love and affection by all her family; sisters Mary, Margaret, Helen and Bridget; brothers John, Martin and (predeceased) Jim; brother and sister-in-law; daughter-in-law, sons-in-law; cherished grandchildren Eleanor, James, Finn, Elsie, Cecilia, Pearse, Elizabeth, Oliver, Hannah, Edward and Grace; nieces, nephews, extended family, friends and neighbours. Reposing at home on Tuesday evening from 5pm to 7pm. Removal on Wednesday morning to the Church of the Holy Cross, Dundrum arriving for Funeral Mass at 10.30am followed by cremation
